scheme_name: Self-Employment Scheme: Nana Vyavasay Mate Loan Yojana
other_conditions: Business must be started within three months of obtaining the loan
Loan to be repaid in equal monthly installments over 5 years after the three‑month period
Only one person per family can avail the scheme
benefits_summary: Loan up to ₹10,00,000 or actual expenditure, whichever is lower.
